faqs.question: What are your hours of operation?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.

faqs.question: How do I submit my internship project?
faqs.answer: You can submit your public GitHub repository link through your Student Workspace.

faqs.question: When will I receive my certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificates are reviewed and issued within 3-5 business days after your code review.

faqs.question: How do I contact student support or my mentor?
faqs.answer: You can reach our student support team at support@datheon.edu or connect with your mentor through the Student Workspace portal.

faqs.question: What are the technical requirements for the Python track?
faqs.answer: You need Python 3.8 or higher installed, an IDE such as VS Code or PyCharm, and standard terminal access. Standard library modules (os, shutil, csv, re, json) are used.

faqs.question: Can I request an extension on my project deadline?
faqs.answer: Yes, an extension of up to 48 hours can be requested via the 'Request Extension' form inside your Student Workspace prior to the deadline.

faqs.question: How is my project evaluated?
faqs.answer: Projects are evaluated on four key pillars: functional requirements compliance (40%), code quality and organization (25%), unit test coverage (20%), and documentation (15%).
